Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/retry_limit.phpt","function":"<global>","line":8,"var":"$regex","code":"$regex = 'A(B|C+)+D|AC+X';","note":"The test corpus shows that nested quantified alternation patterns are accepted by mbstring and exercise Oniguruma's compiler and matcher."},
{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_exec","line":900,"var":"arg_pattern","code":"re = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, options, MBREX(current_mbctype), MBREX(regex_default_syntax));","note":"The attacker-controlled pattern is compiled through mbstring into an Oniguruma regex object."},
{"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5441,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"if (d == 0) { qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body); }","note":"Compilation enters quantifier tuning; empty-repeat bodies trigger the recursive memory-node analysis implicated by the crash report."},
{"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"This recursive helper walks the regex AST under quantifiers and alternations to classify emptiness and memory-node behavior."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4904,"var":"NODE_CAR(node)","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(NODE_CAR(node));","note":"Nested list/alt nodes are traversed recursively, so a crafted pattern can force repeated visits through the same logical subtree."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5629,"var":"r","code":"r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);","note":"The compiler propagates the derived state into the rest of the regex tree, including backtrack and memory bookkeeping."},
{"step":7,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_onig_search","line":880,"var":"err","code":"err = onig_search_with_param(reg, str, end, start, range, region, option, mp);","note":"The compiled regex is executed against the subject string; the vulnerable compiler state can then surface as a heap-use-after-free in Oniguruma's quantifier/memory-node handling."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace updated')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
